ns2:course.label: Logistics Management
ns2:course.description: (B ADM 369) Treats the total flow of materials from their acquisition as basic or unprocessed supplies to delivery of the finished product, as well as the related counter-flows of information that both record and control material movement. Major topics include forecasting material requirements; transportation planning; order processing system; raw material, in-process and finished goods inventory management; packaging; in plant and field warehousing; location theory (space, time, and cost trade- offs); communications; and control. Prerequisite: BADM 324 or BADM 327. Junior standing
